### 🎯 Issue Type
What type of UX issue are you experiencing?

#### Usability Issues
- [ ] **Navigation Problems** - Difficulty navigating the interface
- [ ] **Confusing Interface** - Interface is confusing or unclear
- [ ] **Complex Workflows** - Workflows are too complex
- [ ] **Poor Discoverability** - Features are hard to discover
- [ ] **Inconsistent Design** - Inconsistent design patterns
- [ ] **Information Overload** - Too much information at once
- [ ] **Poor Feedback** - Lack of clear user feedback
- [ ] **Unclear Labels** - Labels and text are unclear

- [ ] **Color Contrast** - Color contrast issues
- [ ] **Font Size** - Font size and readability issues

- [ ] **Laggy Animations** - Animations are laggy or choppy
- [ ] **Loading Times** - Long loading times
- [ ] **Memory Usage** - High memory usage affecting UX
- [ ] **Battery Drain** - Excessive battery drain
- [ ] **Network Issues** - Network performance affecting UX
- [ ] **Rendering Issues** - Rendering performance problems
- [ ] **Input Lag** - Input lag or delayed responses
